stem: Which constitutional issue contributed to sectional conflict before the Civil War?

options.label: A
options.text: Disagreement over the boundaries of the Oregon Territory

options.label: B
options.text: Growing support for limiting female suffrage and immigration

options.label: C
options.text: The limits on free speech and press included in the Alien and Sedition Acts

options.label: D
options.text: Debate over the expansion of slavery into the West
